web.title: Float math tradeoffs — libm, qf_math, and fixed-point on embedded targets
web.description: On a Cortex-M0 without an FPU, sinf via newlib can take thousands of cycles because every float multiply inside the polynomial evaluation is itself a soft-float call.

web.title: Newlib Math Library (libm) | eblot/newlib | DeepWiki
web.description: The Newlib Math Library (libm) provides a comprehensive suite of mathematical functions ranging from standard ISO C99 floating-point routines to complex number arithmetic. The library is designed to be portable across various embedded architectures while allowing for high-performance, machine-specific overrides where hardware support (like an FPU) is available.
